player_prompt.intro:
O modiri {player_id} mo SimpleTak.
Mo borong, maje a gago a bonala e le '{player_stone}' maje a mothusi wa gago a bonala e le '{opponent_stone}'.

Ka nako ya gago, kgetha selo e le lengwe (ka nomba ya yone) le beleselela jwa gago mo go yona.
Ka sekai, '[12]' se beleselela jwa gago mo selong 12.

Pelo ya gago ke go dira tsela e e tsamayanang ya maje a gago e e tsenang ditshwantsho tse pedi tsa boro (mo godimo go ya go feta tshimologo kgotsa mo lefatsheng go ya go feta borwa).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Sebopego sa go sutisa se sa amogelesegang
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nomba ya selo {cell_num} e ilega. E tlhoka go nna magareng ga 0 le {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sele {cell_num} e setse e tsentswe. Tlhopha sele e se nang sepe.

action.placement: Modiri {current_player_id} o beleselela semelo sa gagwe ({symbol}) mo seleng {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Modiri {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') o tsenye ditshwantsho tse pedi tse di emelang!
outcome.draw: Boto e tletse. Ga go na ope yo o tshamekang!
